model.summary: Model favors CHI by 10.0 points (80% win chance). Biggest factors: Elo rating (CHI +4.4), Rest days (home minus away) (CHI +1.7), Rushing offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (CHI +1.4). The baseline of +1.9 covers typical home-field advantage.

total_model.summary: Model projects 42.5 total points (CHI 26, NO 16). Biggest factors: Wind x pass rate (lowers total 1.5), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 1.0), Wind speed (lowers total 0.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.

qb_what_if.note: Approximate: swaps only the quarterback rating and the model's QB-change flag (a new starter counts as a change). Team offense and defense form stay as they are. A positive margin change favors the home team.
